versions.content: Available space of user data with PncBitVector If NmClus- ter . nmPncParticipation is set to true (i.e. partial network is enabled on that NmCluster ) then user data may be defined in the range: • if the user data is mapped between the NM system bytes (CBV, Nid) and the PncBitVector, then the size of user data range is determined by the difference between System . pncVectorOffset and the length of the system bytes (Nid, CBV). • if the user data is mapped after the PncBitVector, then the size of user data range is determined by the difference between NmPdu . length and the last byte position of the PncBitVector.
